transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Your Name]. What brings you in today?

Hi. Um... I guess I'm here because people are starting to notice some things. I just... I keep getting up when I'm supposed to stay put. Like at work during client interviews, or tutoring sessions... even book club. I just can't seem to sit and listen.
Do you often feel restless or have a hard time staying seated even when you try?

Um... yeah. Even if I don't actually get up, I guess I'm still... moving. Like if I'm stuck at the computer combing through records, my foot is usually bouncing under the desk. Or I'm clicking a pen. I just shift around a lot... sometimes so much that I lose my place in what I'm reading. So, I guess I do.
Do you find it hard to focus on tasks or conversations without getting distracted easily?
Um... no, I don't think so. I haven't really noticed a problem with focusing. It's mostly just... what I said before. The sitting still part.
